messages.content: "What is the function of the molecule ATP in the mitochondria and does it have a specific function within this organelle? Also, can you tell me the function of the molecule DNA in the nucleus and whether it has a specific function within the nucleus?"

function.name: cell_biology_function_lookup
function.description: Look up the function of a given molecule in a specified organelle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

specific_function.description: If set to true, a specific function of the molecule within the organelle will be provided, if such information exists.

message.content:
ATP in mitochondria: ATP is primarily produced in mitochondria through oxidative phosphorylation, where it serves as the main energy currency for cellular processes. It does not have a more specific function beyond being the universal energy carrier in this organelle.  

DNA in nucleus: DNA stores genetic information and directs protein synthesis via transcription and replication. Within the nucleus, its specific function is to encode genes that are transcribed into RNA, which is then translated into proteins.
message.reasoning: The user asks about two molecules: ATP in mitochondria and DNA in nucleus. They want the function of each molecule in the organelle and whether it has a specific function within that organelle. We need to provide the function of ATP in mitochondria and indicate if it has a specific function. Then provide the function of DNA in nucleus and indicate if it has a specific function. The user wants both pieces of information. We can answer directly.
